svg.title: Cosmic Ascendant — Weight of the Stars. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Celestial Alignment forks into Collapsing Star then Supernova Unbound, or Searing Starlight then Light of Dead Stars. Gravity Well forks into Event Horizon then Heart of the Singularity, or Stellar Siphon then Hunger of the Void. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Cosmic Ascendant-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

Its only Damage row is Cosmic Explosion at 50 EP, the Nuke tier, so the Burst route follows the director pattern of Blood-Enchanted Eyes and Shakunetsu Sakura: a percentage setup on the Hidden Art and a controlled +2 Damage payoff (Explosion 50 \u2192 52, flagged for director review) in place of the pre-batch +5 (50 \u2192 55). Celestial Alignment answers \"How do I make the enemy I mark fall faster?\": Supernova Unbound charges the caster, opens both marks and detonates a stronger Explosion into the window, while Light of Dead Stars makes every hit on Cosmic Intent's target burn. Gravity Well answers \"How do I outlast the exchange: harden myself, or drain and blunt them?\": Heart of the Singularity raises Decrease Damage Taken on all three guard casts, and Hunger of the Void leeches from Intent while Cosmic Aura blunts its target."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Celestial Alignment","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"When the stars fall into line, the enemy is laid bare and the ascendant burns brighter.","coverage_note":"Increase Damage Taken 35 \u2192 37% on Cosmic Intent and Cosmic Chains (enemy, 2 rounds); Increase Damage Given 35 \u2192 37% on Cosmic Energy (self, 2 rounds).","parent_rule":"ALL","potency_classification":"Cosmic Ascendant","scope":"all Cosmic Ascendant-classified jutsu","minimum_path_bp":1,"coverage":{"jutsu":["Cosmic Chains","Cosmic Energy","Cosmic Intent"],"effect_rows":3,"rows_via_authored_classification":3}},{"id":"02","name":"Collapsing Star","category":"Hidden Art","cost":1,"parents":["01"],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":3,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"}],"flavor":"A star does not go quietly. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
COSMIC ASCENDANT CLASSIFICATION · REQUIRES CLASSIFICATION EXTENSION
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Cosmic Ascendant-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Light of Dead Stars path + Collapsing Star
Heart of the Singularity path + Celestial Alignment
Hunger of the Void path + Event Horizon
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE COSMIC ASCENDANT KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Cosmic Ascendant classification / forked tree
